text: In accordance with Section 9A of the Consolidated Rules of Procedure for the Property Standards Committee, as amended, each Panel shall adopt a schedule of meetings to hear appeals for each year. Please note that meetings for the Property Standards Committee, North York Panel, will be held remotely until further notice.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel, approved the following meeting date for 2026: Wednesday, February 25, 2026 Wednesday, March 25, 2026 Wednesday, April 29, 2026 Wednesday, May 27, 2026 Wednesday, June 24, 2026 Wednesday, July 29, 2026 Wednesday, September 23, 2026 Wednesday, October 28, 2026 Wednesday, November 25, 2026 Wednesday, December 16, 2026
